parts.text: Answer in at most 160 words. A parent Research node contains Sources={A, Shared} and Counterexamples={B, Shared}. Shared answers once, B times out, and A disagrees with Shared. Design the coordinator result contract: give one dispatch rule, a compact data representation, one invariant, and one acceptance test. Preserve both paths to Shared and do not manufacture consensus. Answer the question only; no external actions or ongoing work.

{"structured": {"answer": "Dispatch Rule: Query A, B, and Shared concurrently, storing each source's immediate response or status.Compact Data: {\"A\": \"result_A\", \"Shared\": \"result_Shared\", \"B_status\": \"timeout\", \"A_disagrees_Shared\": true}.Invariant: The contract always captures distinct non-timeout outputs from all queried sources and explicitly reports disagreements without fabricating consensus.Acceptance Test: If A returns 'X', Shared returns 'Y' (where X != Y), and B times out, the contract must yield {\"A\": \"X\", \"Shared\": \"Y\", \"B_status\": \"timeout\", \"A_disagrees_Shared\": true}."}, "model": "gemini-2.5-flash", "provider": "vertex-ai"}
